title: Flesh-eating screwworms feast on humans in Mexico; human cases top 500
summary: The geographic distribution of the human cases unsurprisingly mirrored the distribution of reported animal cases. So far, no human NWS myiasis cases have been reported in the US from the fly’s resurgence.
